ab.d: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 1. If that attack targets a FORTIFICATION, improve the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack by 2 instead.

This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*

Each time a unit with this ability makes a **normal**, **advance** or **fall-back move**: 
- Models in that unit can move through models (including **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models, but excluding **TITANIC** models) and can move horizontally through sections of **terrain features** that are 4" or less in height. 
- Before moving that unit, you can select for all models in that unit to have the **MOBILE** keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is battle-shocked. 
***Designer’s Note:** Gaining the **MOBILE** keyword for the duration of a move will enable models in that unit to move horizontally through **dense terrain features** (13.06).*
While this model has 1-10 wounds remaining, subtract 5 from this model's Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
This model has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

If your Army Faction is **^^Imperial Knights^^**, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army's Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part.

To determine your army's Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army's Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

**Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch**
■ Each time this unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge have the **^^Psyker^^** keyword, you can re-roll the Charge roll. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[PRECISION]** ability while targeting **^^Psyker^^** units. 

**Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds**
■ Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the wound roll

■ This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the nearest enemy unit. 

**Uphold the Honour of the Emperor**

■ At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's level of control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of the phase. 
■ If the mission you are playing features Actions, this unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

If your Army Faction is **^^Imperial Knights^^**, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army's Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part.

To determine your army's Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army's Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your Transport after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move this phase and cannot declare a charge this turn (unless the Transport has the Assault Ramp ability), but can otherwise act normally.

stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features. If your unit is a Heavy Transport, that move can also pass through and within Engagement Range of enemy models (excluding Monster/Vehicle) without ending within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a friendly Heavy Transport unit with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed and rolled a 6 for that ability.
stratagems.tg: That Heavy Transport unit (you can target it even though it was just destroyed).
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability resolves and before any embarked units perform an emergency disembarkation. While moving, it can move through and within Engagement Range of enemy models (excluding Monster/Vehicle) without ending within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in your unit.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase

stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and their Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator unit from your army not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it hasn't fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 3+, don't remove it from play — it fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed from play.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.fx: That objective marker remains under your control, even with no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any phase.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase

stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army equipped with one or more Torrent weapons.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle and Fly units) within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Transport unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: One unit embarked within that Transport can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit (if it is an eligible target).

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets the closest eligible target within 6", add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit Falls Back.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.fx: Place your unit into strategic reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEEDER unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within 24" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range until your unit has shot.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged SPEEDER unit.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS]. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.fx: That objective marker remains under your control, even with no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the end of a phase.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Terminator unit from your army not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into strategic reserves.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Dreadnought, Terminator, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, or Vanguard Veteran Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One TANK ACE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, reroll a Wound roll of 1 (reroll the Wound roll entirely instead if the target is below its Starting Strength).
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted with this and Target Weak Point in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One TANK ACE unit from your army (excluding units containing a model with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is visible and an eligible target.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One TANK ACE unit from your army (excluding units containing a model with a Wounds characteristic of 16+) that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One TANK ACE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
stratagems.rs: A unit cannot be targeted with this and Kill Shot in the same phase.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability in a turn they disembarked from a Drop Pod, or while targeting an enemy unit within 12".

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was targeted, and one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod unit within 9" of it.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability, and each ranged attack targeting one of your units gets the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit from your army that was not set up on the battlefield this turn, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
stratagems.fx: If your Infantry unit is wholly within 6" of that Transport, it can embark within it.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a pile-in or consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a battle-shock test at -1; if failed, it is suppressed until the start of your next turn — while suppressed, each attack made by a model in that unit has -1 to the Hit roll.
stratagems.rs: Cannot be used more than once per battle round.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability, and each time a model in your unit attacks a Character unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: End of the Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in your unit.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it hasn't fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, don't remove it from play — it fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed from play.

stratagems.ph: Charge phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not declared a charge or been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
stratagems.rs: Cannot be used more than once per turn.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6"+1.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army ends a Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. It remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If it is a Phobos or Scout Squad unit, it's also eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: Up to two Phobos and/or Scout Squad units, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit, from your army, none within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into strategic reserves.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry or Mounted unit from your army within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" — or up to 6" instead if it is a Phobos or Scout Squad unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack targeting an enemy unit more than 12" away, improve the BS and Armour Penetration of that attack by 1. If a model is destroyed as a result, its unit must take a battle-shock test.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Mounted or Fly Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each attack targeting your unit has -1 to the Hit roll and -1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Infantry or Mounted unit from your army within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS]. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability — or both abilities instead, if it is a Mounted unit.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES Mounted or Fly Vehicle unit from your army not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into strategic reserves.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit starts an action.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has -3" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move up to 6" (instead of 3") when making Pile-in and Consolidation moves.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge against a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.tg: That enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test with -1 to the result.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit's melee attacks have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, before a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit makes a Consolidation move.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's models are not required to end that Consolidation move closer to the closest enemy model.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One friendly CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR unit within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit re-rolls Hit rolls of 1; against MONSTER and VEHICLE units, it also re-rolls Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT if it disembarked from one this turn.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit as a target.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of each attack that targets your unit.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit re-rolls Wound rolls of 1; if the TRANSPORT it disembarked from has the LAND RAIDER keyword, it re-rolls all Wound rolls instead.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn declares a charge.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Models in your unit can move through other models (but not models' bases) when making that charge move, as long as they end that move closer to the closest enemy model and not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit they are not charging.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly LAND RAIDER model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within it can disembark, and can be set up anywhere within 6" of it, including within Engagement Range of enemy units.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6).

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +2 Strength.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.fx: The falling back enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode for that move, with -1 to those hazard rolls if it is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.when: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, if your unit or its target is within range of an objective marker, your unit's melee attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army within 6" of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Your unit declares and resolves a charge against an eligible enemy unit; it does not receive the bonuses it would normally get for charging.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected a friendly ANCIENT unit as a target.
stratagems.tg: That ANCIENT unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target your unit.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a friendly ANCIENT model is destroyed (and Refusal to Yield was not used on it).
stratagems.tg: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army visible to the enemy unit that destroyed it.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit's attacks that target that enemy unit have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a friendly ANCIENT model is destroyed.
stratagems.tg: That model.
stratagems.fx: Set that model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, with all of its wounds restored.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit's ranged attacks have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and its attacks are unaffected by modifiers to hit rolls, Ballistic Skill, or Weapon Skill.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 Strength.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Character unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.

stratagems.n: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one non-Character model in your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the Character keyword.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.rs: You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is The Sanguinor.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
stratagems.tg: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Fall Back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit from your army ends a charge move.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has Advanced.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase.

stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.tg: One Blood Angels unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.fx: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army Advances.

You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of all of its attacks.

If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, or if it is below Starting Strength, it can move up to 6" instead. In either case, it can only do so provided your unit ends that Pile-in move in Unit Coherency and within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.tg: One DEATH COMPANY unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of an objective marker you controlled.
stratagems.fx: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and, unless your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit is within 12" of one or more friendly CHAPLAIN models, or it is below its Starting Strength, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

stratagems.fx: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle: while a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, reroll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker, you can reroll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One DEATHWING unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.when: Command phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase

stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That enemy unit becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.

stratagems.fx: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
stratagems.rs: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.rs: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
stratagems.rs: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
stratagems.rs: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: Up to two Kill Team units from your army, or one other Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army, if those units are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.fx: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, models in those units that do not have the Deep Strike ability have the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.tg: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Stealth.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.tg: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly WOLF GUARD TERMINATORS unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battleshock roll, with -1 to that battleshock roll if that enemy unit is at or below half-strength.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.fx: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.
stratagems.fx: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One WULFEN INFANTRY or BLOOD CLAWS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, after your unit has shot, select one enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER, or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit has the SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY or THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY keywords, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.when: Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Wolf Guard Headtaker or Wolf Guard Terminator Pack Leader model from your army.
stratagems.fx: Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the CHARACTER keyword.

stratagems.ph: Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can reroll the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One Space Wolves unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Walker unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models (excluding Titanic models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within Engagement Range of them.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.
stratagems.fx: Select one Hunting Pack from the Master of Wolves Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hunting Pack is active for your unit instead of any other Hunting Pack that is active, even if you have already selected that Hunting Pack this battle.

stratagems.ph: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a Space Wolves unit, until the end of the turn, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES INFANTRY or SPACE WOLVES BEASTS unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SPACE WOLVES unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.tg: That SPACE WOLVES unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One SPACE WOLVES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: Two ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army (excluding BEASTS) that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit visible to both of your units. Until the end of the phase, models in your units can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in one of your units makes an attack, reroll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: Two ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, or one SPACE WOLVES BEASTS unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.tg: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged GREY HUNTERS unit.
stratagems.fx: Select one visible enemy unit within 24" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly GREY HUNTERS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That GREY HUNTERS unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit's melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] (your choice).

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly GREY HUNTERS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.tg: That GREY HUNTERS unit.
stratagems.fx: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
